translationRepairs: In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Guoquan’s victorious drive along the Yangtze strongholds toward Jiangning, helped capture Zhenjiang, and took Moling Pass, earning nomination as regional commander.

In the first year of Tongzhi he followed Guoquan’s victorious drive along the Yangtze strongholds toward Jiangning, jointly took Danyang Town, and seized Moling Pass, earning nomination as regional commander.
s0011 has 會取丹陽鎮, 奪秣陵關, not 鎮江. Zhenjiang is a different place; Danyang Town matches the Chinese, and jointly took / seized tracks 會取 and 奪.

In the first year of Tongzhi, following Guoquan in pressing the advantage down the Yangtze’s fortified towns and passes and advancing on Jiangning, Chendian jointly took Zhenjiang and seized Moling Pass, and was recorded by name as a regional commander.

In the first year of Tongzhi, following Guoquan in pressing the advantage down the Yangtze’s fortified towns and passes and advancing on Jiangning, Chendian jointly took Danyang Town and seized Moling Pass, and was recorded by name as a regional commander.
The literal line likewise turns 丹陽鎮 into Zhenjiang. The source names Danyang Town.

The navy captured Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jingzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, then took Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle; riding the momentum they pressed Jiangning, and Fusi was nominated provincial commander-in-chief.

The navy captured Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jinzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, then took Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle; riding the momentum they pressed Jiangning, and Fusi was nominated provincial commander-in-chief.
s0047 has 破金柱關. 金 is Jin, not Jing; Jingzhu Pass is a misreading of the first character.

The naval force took Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jingzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, advanced to take Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle, pressed the advantage against Jiangning, and he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.

The naval force took Taiping and Wuhu, broke Jinzhu Pass and East Liang Mountain, advanced to take Moling Pass and Jiangxin Isle, pressed the advantage against Jiangning, and he was recorded by name as provincial commander-in-chief.
The literal field has the same Jingzhu error for 金柱關.
Li Xiucheng hid in a private house; Fusi tracked him down and took him, along with Hong Rendeng.
Li Xiucheng hid in a private house; Fusi tracked him down and took him, along with Hong Renda.
s0059 names 洪仁達. 達 is da; Rendeng invents a different given name.
Li Xiucheng hid in a civilian house; Fusi searched him out and captured him, and also seized Hong Rendeng.
Li Xiucheng hid in a civilian house; Fusi searched him out and captured him, and also seized Hong Renda.
The literal field repeats Hong Rendeng for 洪仁達; Hong Renda is the matching romanization.
Jiangxi paid no rations; Zhang Fei, shielded in southern Anhui, supplied the funds that kept the army from breaking up.
Jiangxi paid no rations; Zhang Fu, shielded in southern Anhui, supplied the funds that kept the army from breaking up.
s0072 names 張芾. Zhang Fei is 張飛, another person; 芾 is Fu.
Jiangxi did not provide pay; Zhang Fei, relying on his screen in southern Anhui, supplied funds, and only then did the army not disperse.
Jiangxi did not provide pay; Zhang Fu, relying on his screen in southern Anhui, supplied funds, and only then did the army not disperse.
The literal field likewise gives Zhang Fei for 張芾.

When the main force closed on Jiangning, Yuju and the other commanders took separate routes to seize Zhenjiang, Moling Pass, and other strongpoints, leveling dozens of rebel forts before assaulting the stone citadel at Yuhuatai, which the rebels held at all costs and would not yield.

When the main force closed on Jiangning, Yuju and the other commanders took separate routes to seize Danyang Town, Moling Pass, and other strongpoints, leveling dozens of rebel forts before assaulting the stone citadel at Yuhuatai, which the rebels held at all costs and would not yield.
s0129 lists 丹陽鎮、秣陵關諸要隘. Zhenjiang (鎮江) is not in the Chinese.

As the main army pressed Jiangning, Yuju with the various generals took separate routes to capture Zhenjiang, Moling Pass, and other key passes, leveled dozens of rebel forts, and advanced against the stone fortress at Yuhuatai; the rebels fought to the death and it was not taken.

As the main army pressed Jiangning, Yuju with the various generals took separate routes to capture Danyang Town, Moling Pass, and other key passes, leveled dozens of rebel forts, and advanced against the stone fortress at Yuhuatai; the rebels fought to the death and it was not taken.
The literal field makes the same Zhenjiang substitution for 丹陽鎮.
He then served under Guoquan, captured Ji'an and Anqing, rose to brigade commander, and received the title Zhuyong Batulu.
He then served under Guoquan, captured Ji'an and recaptured Anqing, rose to brigade commander, and received the title Zhuyong Batulu.
復安慶 is recapture, which the original omits. The bundled insertion of Zeng is unnecessary given the chapter’s given-name idiom; keep Guoquan and restore recaptured.
